_comment: Persistent character memory for Boopaloo Kids. recurring_characters = manually pinned characters (e.g. a channel mascot) that must look IDENTICAL in every episode; they always override a story's version. registry = auto-maintained by Module 6: it remembers every character ever generated so a re-used name keeps its original look across episodes. To make a recurring character actually APPEAR in new stories, also add its name to the Module 4 story prompt.
art_style_reference: Cinematic children's storybook illustration, soft painterly digital art, warm golden lighting. Keep this in sync with prompts/scene-config.json -> image_style so every episode shares one look.

mimi.name: Mimi
mimi.description: A tiny, energetic desert jerboa who loves to zoom and hop.
mimi.visual_description: A palm-sized, creamy-yellow jerboa with giant, round black eyes, long tufted ears like bunny ears, extremely long springy back legs, and a tiny pink nose. She wears a little cherry-red backpack made of a flower petal.

barnaby.name: Barnaby
barnaby.description: A wise, slow-moving giant desert tortoise who loves quiet moments.
barnaby.visual_description: A large, dome-shelled tortoise with dusty-green skin, gentle wrinkled eyes, and a shell painted with tiny, colorful wildflower patterns. He wears a small, straw sunhat tied under his chin with a green ribbon.
